question: In a certain code language, A is written as 26 and O is written as 12. How will AMAZON be written as in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/094413ca23e189e59a3d82079258703e8647a6aa49a3c37196c6d31304d23587.png] 

The logic followed here is:-

♦ Alphabets are assigned the positional value of the opposite letter or in the reverse alphabetical order.

 
• So, AMAZON can be written as:-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9cb36289422f7c678bf199b74ca7b8fce8633dbd9b05c0d48f378d99559767c2.png] 

 
• Code for AMAZON will be 26142611213.
 
• Hence, '**option 1'** is the correct answer.
